text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we passed 
by a park where a second-hand book fair 
was being held.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's so lively here. Oh. There's a 
picture book corner too...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A ton of delicious-looking pancakes show 
up in this, you know. I feel like I can 
even catch a whiff of their sweet aroma. 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, that book! It's a story about a 
clumsy fairy who causes trouble. Yet, 
she's somehow endearing and so adorable."
choice_data_list: You really do love picture books, huh.

You really do love picture books, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Just by opening them up, you can see 
all sorts of different worlds.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! That book...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I've always wanted this! It's been 
my favorite ever since I was a kid!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It was on the bookshelf at the hospital, 
but... by the time I tried to buy it, it 
was already out of print...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, I'll... go buy this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the used book fair, we 
stopped by a cafe. Since she kept glancing 
at the picture book she bought on the way, 
I suggested we read it before heading back 
to the academy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wah... My heart's racing... I've really 
wanted to re-read this for so long...!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Picture books! I have lots of them 
too! Do you like picture books too, big 
sister?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, hello. Yes, I like it. We're 
matching, aren't we? Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry about my child! We'll go 
right back to our seats! ……Come on, let's 
go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
No nooo! I wanna stay here! Hey, hey, 
miss, read that book! I wanna read it too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, if it's all right, would it be 
okay if I read a story to you?"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Huh? U-Um... ...Excuse me, would that be 
all right...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Well then... without 
further ado, shall I read it with you?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yay! Read it, read it! Hurry, hurry—!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then why don't you come sit next to 
me? You'll be able to see way more of the 
drawings that way.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho... Yeah, I can see it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, wonderful. Shall I start reading, 
then?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Once upon a time, there was a kingdom 
troubled by a monster. The monster would 
attack, demanding food."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"One day, the normally gentle king went to 
battle against a monster taller than the 
trees."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, monster! I won't let you cause any 
more trouble!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
""Silence! Just hand over the food! I've 
decided! Today's meal is... going to be 
YOUUU!!""

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“The King continued to fight and finally 
cornered the monster. But just then, the 
monster's hungry child appeared.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Was the food... meant for the children? 
...If you truly reflect on your actions, 
we welcome you both to our kingdom. Let us 
all share a meal together."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're forgiving me...? This is the first 
time a human has ever been kind to me... 
I'm sorry for everything. I won't do 
anything bad ever again."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
""And so, thanks to the kind king, the 
monster had a change of heart. From then 
on, the monster and its child ate their 
meals together with everyone else.""

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "The End"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Waaa! Your Majesty, that's amaziiing! That 
was so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this girl, honestly... Um, thank you 
so very, very much!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't mention it! I'm just glad you 
liked it. It's my absolute favorite book!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by the hand by his mother, the young 
boy walked away with a smile.
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful story reading.
It was such a heartwarming story!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank you... Actually, back when I 
was in the hospital... I practiced a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to cheer up the other kids who 
were patients too. I kept wondering how I 
should read to get them hooked on the 
story... and what would make them smile.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so glad she had fun too. I was 
internally pumping my fist and shouting, 
'Yes!'"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Really!? I'm so glad you like it 
too, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Picture books have simple stories, but 
that makes their message pure and 
powerful, doesn't it? I suppose that's why 
even adults can enjoy them...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have other picture books I love too. 
If it's alright... could I show them to 
you next time?
